authority: Current-source defect and prepared regression only; hosted execution remains pending.

finding.query: Explicit --base and --head are supplied from TurboConfigProofOptions.
finding.before: The affected dry-run receives --affected without TURBO_SCM_BASE/TURBO_SCM_HEAD, so ambient/default refs can describe a different change.
finding.caller: quality turbo-config-proof forwards user --base/--head into options without a surrounding SCM environment override.
finding.additional: Absent or malformed native task arrays were converted to zero tasks by permissive traversal defaults.

repair.reuse: Reuse the existing TurboConfigProofOptions schema and runCaptured helper; no new model, service, proof store or runner.
repair.behavior: Both query and every dry-run child receive the requested SCM refs explicitly, with extendEnv true to preserve the tool environment.
repair.movingRefLimit: Callers requiring an immutable comparison must supply commit SHAs; this component does not claim automatic ref freezing.
repair.taskEnvelopeBoundary: Schema-first required query/dry task arrays; optional package inventory decodes to Option. Valid explicit empty arrays stay zero; malformed envelopes fail with TurboConfigProofError.
repair.payloadSafety: Parser failures contain generic typed messages and do not retain raw native payloads or schema issue values.

checks: Both query and every dry run receive the explicit requested SCM refs, including a nondefault head.
Both selector modes preserve their report source range and the two requested task plans.
The child environment explicitly extends the existing tool environment.

rollback: Revert the SCM environment binding, regression and associated packet entries; treat old affected-mode proof reports as unverified unless their actual comparison refs are independently established.

currentRootObservation.scope: Direct pinned native dry planning on the actual accepted checkout; not an end-to-end execution of the repaired proof wrapper or task qualification.
currentRootObservation.captureDriverLocation: Owned private state, retained outside git; report records native argv, immutable refs and source bindings.
